datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule (February, June, October 2016) across Mozambique administrative units. The data represents current situation assessments of acute food insecurity phases, which are proxy indicators of drought-related food security impacts on populations.
